theorems.statement: ∀ (d : ℕ) (φ : Euclid d → Euclid d) (V : Set (Euclid d)) (z₀ : Euclid d), IsOpen V → z₀ ∈ V → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 φ V → Injective (fderiv ℝ φ z₀) → ∃ (V₀ O : Set (Euclid d)) (χ : Euclid d → Euclid d), IsOpen V₀ ∧ IsOpen O ∧ z₀ ∈ V₀ ∧ V₀ ⊆ V ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ 1 χ O ∧ MapsTo χ O V₀ ∧ (∀ a ∈ O, φ (χ a) = a) ∧ ∀ z ∈ V₀, φ z ∈ O ∧ χ (φ z) = z
